name: Problem Tree Analysis
deliverable: Hierarchical root-cause, core challenge, and downstream effect tree

steps.text: Write the core problem on the trunk in one sentence, with no cause or solution in it.
Ask why, and place root causes two levels deep.
Place consequences above as branches, then circle the roots this team can influence.

failure: The tree becomes a wish list: causes and effects share a level, and the trunk is a vague label.
intervention: Sort each note as a reason below or an effect above, then rewrite the trunk with an actor and a cost.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Used in development and policy analysis; no single documented originator.
